name: Standing Order Search Criteria 5
definition: Defines the criteria which are used to search for standing orders defined within the system.

KeyAttributesIndicator.name: Key Attributes Indicator
KeyAttributesIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the key fields or business attributes defined within the system must be returned.

StandingOrderIdentification.name: Standing Order Identification
StandingOrderIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the standing order used to initiate the liquidity transfer.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Liquidity transfer origin or destination account within the pool of accounts under management of the requestor.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for a standing order, as assigned by the account servicer or the account owner.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Dates during which the standing order is in effect.

SystemMember.name: System Member
SystemMember.definition: Specifies if the account is debited or credited by the standing order.

AssociatedPoolAccount.name: Associated Pool Account
AssociatedPoolAccount.definition: Liquidity transfer origin or destination account within the pool of accounts under management of the requestor.

LinkSetIdentification.name: Link Set Identification
LinkSetIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the link set in which the standing order is defined. The link set is a collection of standing order defined in a specific sequence.

LinkSetOrderIdentification.name: Link Set Order Identification
LinkSetOrderIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify liquidity transfer standing order within the link set.

LinkSetOrderSequence.name: Link Set Order Sequence
LinkSetOrderSequence.definition: Specifies the sequence in which the system will execute the liquidity transfers standing order within the link set when additional liquidity is required.

ZeroSweepIndicator.name: Zero Sweep Indicator
ZeroSweepIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the query shall return all liquidity transfer standing orders defined as zero sweeping orders.|When the indicator is set to true, the liquidity transfer standing order will transfer all amount of money out of the account so the resulting balance is zero.
